_comment: Motion recipes: movements the team has seen in judged references, rebuilt in our own code and tested (motion/index.html passes inspect.mjs with 0 FAIL and 0 WARN at three widths and under reduced motion). Each names what it shows, the message it can carry, when not to use it, its trigger, timing, technique, reduced-motion version, cost and where it was seen (measured facts, never copied code: rules/copyright.md). A recipe with "kit" lives in that kit section. Read with motion.mjs list / find / get. A new reference whose motion fits no recipe gets a new recipe (library/intake.md).

recipes.name: Staged entrance
recipes.shows: The first screen arrives in order: headline, sentence, action, picture.
recipes.carries: Any page: it says what to read first. Required on every page (motion/functions.md → Transitions are required).
recipes.not_when: Never as a loading screen that holds content back; never longer than about 900 ms in total.
recipes.timing: 4 parts, 600 ms each, 90 ms apart (last starts at 240 ms): 840 ms in total; ease-out cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); rise 24px
recipes.technique: CSS keyframes with animation-delay, started only under .js; the content is in the HTML

seen_in.measured: text appears between 0.4 and 1.2 s, the hero video by 2.5 s

recipes.name: Reveal on entry
recipes.shows: The parts of a section rise into place once, one after another, when the section enters the screen.
recipes.carries: Reading order inside a section. The base choreography; quiet on purpose.
recipes.not_when: Not on every single element (that is the fade-up default in rules/defaults.md): one group per section, at most 4 parts.
recipes.technique: IntersectionObserver adds .is-in; CSS transitions with a --i index

seen_in.measured: blocks fade in with transition-opacity as they enter

recipes.name: The product as protagonist
recipes.shows: The real product stays on screen and travels down the page; it turns and lands in each section while the colour field behind it changes with the topic.
recipes.carries: A physical product with variants or steps: 'this is the thing, and here is what it means for you', one point per stop. Ends beside the action.
recipes.not_when: No real product picture; more than 4 stops; on a phone it becomes a still picture at the top of each step.
recipes.trigger: scroll, while a tall section is pinned (data-progress="pin")
recipes.timing: follows the scroll: rotation ±13°, travel 9vh; colour fields cross-fade over about 12% of the section
recipes.technique: position: sticky stage + a --p custom property (0..1) written on scroll with requestAnimationFrame; transform and opacity only
recipes.reduced: --p is not written: the product stands still, the first colour field stays
recipes.cost: one sticky panel (not full-screen); no layout shift when the stage has a fixed height
recipes.needs: a cut-out product picture (PNG/SVG) and one colour per stop

seen_in.measured: a can travels from the hero through the benefit cards; gsap + ScrollTrigger, up to 25 script-driven elements per step; their version shifts layout (CLS 1.97), ours must not

recipes.name: The picture grows out of its frame
recipes.shows: A picture starts smaller inside its frame and grows to full width as it is scrolled into view.
recipes.carries: 'This is the event': the dish, the room, the place the page is about.
recipes.not_when: More than once per page; on a weak picture (it enlarges the weakness).
recipes.timing: scale .72 → 1 over the first 45% of the crossing
recipes.technique: transform: scale() from --p, transform-origin at the top
recipes.cost: none: the box keeps its layout size
recipes.needs: one strong picture at least 1600px wide

seen_in.measured: the hero photograph grows from its arch frame to full width on scroll

recipes.name: Type as image
recipes.shows: A word or a date set as large as the screen drifts sideways behind the content.
recipes.carries: A date, a place or a name that IS the message; pictures can be laid over it.
recipes.not_when: The word is not the message; more than one per page. The real text stays in a normal heading: the giant word is aria-hidden.
recipes.timing: drifts 34% of its own width across the crossing
recipes.technique: transform: translateX() from --p; overflow: clip on the section
recipes.cost: none; check the phone: the word must not push the page wider

seen_in.measured: 210px display type; letters and the date '24 FEB 2022' fill the screen behind photographs
display type as the first-screen picture

recipes.name: Pictures land one by one
recipes.shows: Photographs arrive one after another, each with a small turn, like prints put on a table.
recipes.carries: Evidence that piles up: places, cases, people. The order they land in is the order of the story.
recipes.not_when: Decorative stock pictures; more than 6 pictures; a section that must be read fast.
recipes.timing: 110 ms apart; 320 ms fade, 600 ms settle; from 3× the final angle and 92% size
recipes.technique: IntersectionObserver + CSS transitions; each figure has --r (its angle) and --i (its order)

seen_in.measured: dated photographs land over the giant date, each rotated
tilted photographs as the portfolio's device

recipes.name: The ground changes with the chapter
recipes.shows: The whole page changes its ground colour when the story turns.
recipes.carries: A turn in the storyline (problem → answer, day → night, before → after). One or two per page.
recipes.not_when: A new colour for every section with no turn in the story; any ground that breaks text contrast (check both grounds).
recipes.trigger: the chapter passes the middle of the screen (both directions)
recipes.technique: IntersectionObserver sets body[data-ground]; the tokens --ground and --ink change, background-color and color transition (paint only, no layout)
recipes.cost: every colour must come from tokens, or parts of the page keep the old ground

seen_in.measured: yellow turns black where the story turns to destruction

recipes.name: State changes move
recipes.shows: A panel opens by growing, its content fades in; closing is the same, reversed.
recipes.carries: Required wherever something opens, closes, switches or submits (accordion, tabs, steps, form states).
recipes.not_when: Never 'none' while the page has states that change.
recipes.technique: grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr with opacity; button[aria-expanded] + aria-controls; page changes and shared elements use the View Transitions API
recipes.cost: layout moves, but after a user action (not counted as layout shift)

seen_in.measured: accordion-slide-down / -up and collapsible keyframes; transitions of 0.15 to 0.75 s

recipes.name: Numbers that never show zero
recipes.shows: A number runs up to its value when it enters the screen.
recipes.carries: A real, sourced number worth a second look. Sample numbers stay marked as samples.
recipes.not_when: Invented numbers (SKILL.md: never invent proof); more than 3 counters.
recipes.timing: 900 ms, from 80% of the value, ease-out
recipes.technique: the real number is in the HTML; a small script counts on entry and formats with Intl.NumberFormat

seen_in.measured: the fault this recipe avoids: counters showed 0 until animated, 2 stayed hidden under reduced motion

recipes.name: A line that draws the journey
recipes.shows: A line draws itself along a route as the section is scrolled, passing each step.
recipes.carries: A process, a route or a timeline: 'this is how it goes, in this order'.
recipes.not_when: Steps that are not a sequence; a line with no stops.
recipes.timing: complete at about 60% of the crossing
recipes.technique: SVG path with pathLength=1 and stroke-dashoffset from --p (paint only)

seen_in.measured: the opening is one thin line and a dot that grow into the title circle

recipes.name: The work builds beside the story
recipes.shows: A picture stays in place while the steps of the story pass it; each step adds a part to the picture.
recipes.carries: A service with no product: the visitor watches the work being done.
recipes.not_when: Fewer than 3 steps; a picture that does not change with the steps.
recipes.technique: the kit section story-sticky (kit.mjs get story-sticky)
recipes.reduced: all steps shown as a list with their pictures
recipes.cost: one sticky panel in its own wrapper

seen_in.measured: a client chat, a handwritten note and a redlined document build on scroll

recipes.name: Hover or tap swaps the picture for its result
recipes.shows: A card turns from the packet to the finished dish, from the claim to its source.
recipes.carries: 'What will I actually get?' and 'Is this true?'.
recipes.not_when: Content needed to decide lives only behind hover; no tap path.
recipes.technique: the kit section reveal-cards (kit.mjs get reveal-cards)
recipes.reduced: both states visible, or an instant swap

seen_in.measured: hovering a flavour card turns the packet into the finished bowl; no hover on a phone, so the bowls never showed there
